Terminal Workspace — selected third-party components
Prepared 26 November 2026

ConnectBot termlib 0.3.15
https://github.com/connectbot/termlib
Apache-2.0.txt and termlib-NOTICE.txt

libvterm, vendored revision 847 in termlib 0.3.15
https://www.leonerd.org.uk/code/libvterm/
libvterm-MIT.txt and libvterm-wcwidth-NOTICE.txt

JSch maintained fork 2.28.8
https://github.com/mwiede/jsch
JSch-BSD.txt

JZlib and jBCrypt code retained by the selected JSch artifact
JZlib-BSD.txt and jBCrypt-ISC.txt

Complete applicable license and permission texts for the components above
are included in this directory. provenance.json identifies the inspected
source/artifact origins and the copied text fingerprints.

This selected-component bundle must be reconciled with the final APK's
resolved AndroidX/Kotlin/coroutines/logging and embedded native/resource
inventory before release. It is not yet a complete final-runtime inventory.
License compliance and security verification are separate reviews.
